name: Legrand
old_description: Manufactures wiring devices, switches, sockets, and electrical panel components.
about:
Legrand, headquartered in West Hartford, Connecticut, traces its origins to 1865. The company operates as a global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures, with its North and Central American division serving as the largest segment of the worldwide organization, employing over 9,200 people across the region.

The manufacturer produces a broad range of electrical and digital infrastructure products. Its portfolio includes wiring devices, switches, sockets, and electrical panel components, as well as audio visual solutions, lighting controls and shading systems, and lighting fixtures under brands such as Finelite, Focal Point, Kenall, OCL, and Pinnacle. Legrand also delivers network infrastructure solutions encompassing power distribution, monitoring, access control, and wire and cable management, along with EV charging equipment and critical power systems for data centers.

Legrand serves residential and non‑residential markets, with concrete engagements in commercial construction, education, healthcare, and data center environments. The company highlights its healthcare market virtual experience, data center AI readiness solutions, and EV charging deployments from homes to workplaces and hotels as examples of its customer focus.

The company states its purpose is to improve lives by transforming the spaces where people live, work, and meet through electrical and digital infrastructures that are simple, innovative, and sustainable, positioning itself as the global specialist in building infrastructure transformation.
